issues.title: Original 9-5 MY2005/06 turbo failure after replacement: unprimed bearings or leaking oil feed/return
issues.cause: Original WIS requires oil priming before first start and service of oil feed/return pipe with correct gaskets/banjo torques; lubrication faults can damage a replacement turbo.
symptoms: newly replaced turbo noisy soon after repair
oil seep at turbo oil-line union
unexplained smoke and depleted engine oil
issues.diagnosis_summary: Determine oil feed/return routing, visible leaks and service history with engine safely off/cold; verify OEM port seals and oil-pressure test if qualified. Do not claim internal turbo condition from noise alone.
issues.correction_summary: If replacement genuinely justified, follow full factory priming, O-ring/copper washer and oil/coolant pipe procedure with leak verification; inspect blocked oil feed and unrelated engine pressure faults.
limits: Turbo bearing shaft-play specification still unavailable for MY2008.
Priming prevents a known installation hazard but cannot reverse existing bearing/compressor damage.
Specifications of MY2006 joints not automatically valid for MY2009.

issues.title: 2008 FA57 harsh shifts with SLS/SLT control-circuit faults versus costly clutch damage
issues.cause: SLS/SLT normally vary hydraulic line pressure with controlled 300Hz current; loss of energization causes maximum pressure. WIS distinguishes P0748 SLT and P0785 SLS.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Read true TCM codes/sensor values; confirm battery and grounds, circuit and harness condition, inspect resistance safely at 20°C with power disconnected; do not extrapolate gearshift solenoid S1-5 limits to linear SLS/SLT.
issues.correction_summary: Repair a positively identified circuit/connector/solenoid fault before condemning complete gearbox; internal wear or pressure faults may coexist and still need specialized repair.
limits: No approved valve body replacement part or manufacturer supersession obtained.
Electrical resistance in range cannot verify hydraulic pressure or healthy clutch discs.
2007 technical table and 2008 description have different ranges and must remain separate.

issues.title: Misfiled 9-3 M98–99 Dexron III bulletin cannot be used for original 9-5 FA57
issues.cause: Bulletin 100-2512 edition 3 appears under OG9-5 WIS service tree but text lists 9-3 M98–99 cars affected and Dexron III grade.
symptoms: incorrect fluid recommended solely from Saab WIS folder
technician assumes bulletin later than model year applies
issues.diagnosis_summary: Always check actual Cars affected/market/model-year/gearbox before using a TSB or fluid claim. Compare MY2005–09 9-5 FA57 year-specific original Saab 3309 fluid grade.
issues.correction_summary: Reject 9-3-only bulletin as OG9-5 fitment or service advice; obtain vehicle-specific Saab WIS transmission fluid grade and qualified product approval.
limits: A 2007 9-5 folder does not establish 2007 model-year bulletin scope.
Do not treat Dexron III from 9-3 M98–99 as replacement for OG9-5 FA57 Saab 3309.
No current ATF product certification from the misfiled bulletin.
